profile.name: NanoScanZ显微镜Z轴纳米定位台
profile.description: 这是一种用于显微镜Z轴精密调焦和高度定位的纳米定位台，可进行绝对位移、相对位移、回零与位置读取，并可显示当前行程范围与单位。它常用于显微成像中的焦点扫描、样品高度调整和自动对焦相关实验。
profile.description_en: This is a precision microscope Z-axis nanopositioning stage for fine focusing and height positioning. It supports absolute and relative motion, zeroing, and position readback, and can report travel range and motion units. It is commonly used for focus scans, sample height adjustment, and autofocus-related microscopy experiments.
